name: Vincefeld
source:
Vencefield, king of Vold, is from the reigning tribe of sorcerers.He has built his kingdom using whatever means necessary to accomplish his goals.Vencefield is the one who has caused all of the present trouble in the land. He is a man who believes that power is the all-important factor in life.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
